title: 第7章 绝对把握第8章 天才完美融合
slug: 我金丹呢你当结石摘出来了
lines: 清晨七点五十分，市卫健委考点。
苏业站在考场大楼前，感受着六月清晨的微风拂面。
【水系金丹雏形·精神类】
【融合进度：67%】
【距离完全融合还有约24小时】
融合进度比昨天又高了不少，精神力的提升肉眼可见，昨晚他坐在书桌前翻开江晓月发来的那些资料，本来做好了熬夜的准备，结果发现根本用不着。
四套模拟卷，两千四百道题，他花了不到两个小时就全部过了一遍，每一道题的考点、陷阱、最优解，在脑海中清清楚楚，十年真题汇编，又花了一个小时。
别人几个月的努力，他一个晚上全部拿下了。
现在的苏业感觉自己强的可怕！
考场门口陆陆续续来了不少人，大多是和苏业差不多年纪的年轻面孔，刚毕业的医学生，规培生，有的三五成群地凑在一起翻笔记，有的戴着耳机闭眼默背，有的捧着手机刷题库，表情都写着同一个字，慌！
执医证考试，临床执业医师资格考试，医学生的成人礼。
考不过，就没有独立行医的资格，规培结束也留不了院。
苏业双手插在白大褂口袋里，站在台阶上，表情很平静。
“苏业！”
一个清脆的声音从身后传来。
苏业转头，江晓月正快步走过来，马尾辫在脑后一甩一甩的，旁边还跟着一个女生，圆脸，大眼睛，扎着丸子头，看着挺活泼。
丸子头女生跟着江晓月走到苏业面前，抬头看了他一眼，然后眼睛明显亮了一下。
也不怪她，苏业这几天的变化确实肉眼可见，融合水系金丹之后，整个人的状态格外的好，眼神清亮有神，皮肤干净通透，气质里多了一种说不上来的沉稳感，往那儿一站，和周围那些面色憔悴的考生形成了鲜明的对比。
江晓月倒是没注意这些，她的注意力全在苏业的备考状态上。
她叹了口气，一脸“恨铁不成钢”的表情看着苏业：“你昨晚复习了吗？”
“复习了。”
“复习完了？”
“差不多吧。”
江晓月觉得不可能不过看苏业这般自信的模样，也没再追问，只是认真地看着苏业说：“你要加油啊，你以前的积累已经很足够了，底子在那儿摆着呢，就算遇到没复习过的题也别瞎答，先排除明显错误的选项，剩下的凭临床思维去推，你的临床思维一直很强的……”
苏业看着她一本正经的样子，忍不住笑了一下：“知道了，江老师。”
“少贫。”江晓月白了他一眼，但嘴角还是翘了一下。
她和苏业本科同班，硕士同门，数年的同学加师兄妹，关系一直不错，苏业性格闷，不太爱社交，江晓月就自动承担了“操心”的角色，大到论文选题，小到食堂吃什么，都要管一嘴。
苏业也习惯了。
“行了，进去吧，八点半开考，找好座位先坐着，别迟到。”江晓月挥了挥手。
苏业点点头，转身往考场里走。
他走远之后，旁边的丸子头女生凑到江晓月耳边，小声说：“这就是你老说的你师兄啊？”
“长得还挺精神的嘛，”丸子头女生眨了眨眼，“我以前老听你说你师兄是个天才，超级学霸，年年考核第一那个？”
content_en:
At 7:50 in the morning, the Municipal Health Commission takes the exam.
Su ye stood in front of the examination room building, feeling the breeze blowing on his face in the early morning of June.
[Prototype of water type golden elixir·Spiritual type]
[Fusion progress: 67%]
[There are still about 24 hours until complete integration]
The fusion progress was much higher than yesterday, and the improvement in mental power was visible to the naked eye. Last night, he sat at his desk and opened the information sent by Jiang Xiaoyue. He was originally prepared to stay up late, but he found that it was not necessary at all.
It took him less than two hours to go through four sets of mock papers and 2,400 questions. The test points, traps, and optimal solutions to each question were clear in his mind. It took him another hour to compile ten years of real questions.
After months of hard work by others, he won it all in one night.
Su ye now feels that he is terrifyingly strong!
A lot of people came one after another at the entrance of the examination room, most of them were young faces about the same age as Su ye, freshly graduated medical students, and graduate students. Some gathered in small groups to read notes, some wore headphones and memorized silently with their eyes closed, and some held their mobile phones to browse the question bank. Their expressions all read the same word, panic!
Medical practitioner certificate examination, clinical practitioner qualification examination, coming-of-age ceremony for medical students.
If you fail the exam, you will not be qualified to practice medicine independently, and you will not be able to stay in the hospital after the prescribed training.
Su ye put his hands in the pockets of his white coat and stood on the steps with a calm expression.
"Su ye!"
A crisp voice came from behind.
Su ye turned his head and saw Jiang Xiaoyue walking over quickly, her ponytail swaying behind her head. Next to her was a girl with a round face, big eyes, and a bun. She looked very lively.
The girl with the round head followed Jiang Xiaoyue to Su ye, raised her head and glanced at him, and then her eyes brightened obviously.
It's not her fault. Su Ye's changes in the past few days are indeed visible to the naked eye. After integrating the water-type golden elixir, his overall condition is particularly good. His eyes are clear and energetic, his skin is clean and transparent, and his temperament has an indescribable sense of calmness. When he stands there, he is in sharp contrast with the haggard-looking candidates around him.
Jiang Xiaoyue didn't pay attention to this. Her attention was entirely on Su ye's preparation for the exam.
She sighed and looked at Su ye with an expression that said, "Did you study last night?"
"Reviewed."
"Have you finished reviewing?"
"Almost."
Jiang Xiaoyue thought it was impossible. She looked at Su Ye's confident look and didn't ask any more questions. She just looked at Su Ye seriously and said, "You have to work hard. Your previous accumulation is enough. The foundation is there. Even if you encounter questions that you haven't reviewed before, don't answer blindly. Eliminate the obviously wrong options first, and rely on clinical thinking for the rest. Your clinical thinking has always been very strong..."
Su ye looked at her serious look and couldn't help but smile: "I understand, Teacher Jiang."
"Young poor man." Jiang Xiaoyue rolled her eyes at him, but still raised the corner of her mouth.
She and Su Ye were in the same undergraduate class and master's class. They had been classmates for several years and were brothers and sisters. They had always had a good relationship. Su Ye had a boring personality and was not very social, so Jiang Xiaoyue took the initiative to assume the role of "career", taking care of everything from the topic selection of the paper to what to eat in the cafeteria.
Su ye is also used to it.
"Okay, let's go in. The exam starts at 8:30. Find a seat and sit down first. Don't be late." Jiang Xiaoyue waved her hand.
Su ye nodded, turned around and walked into the examination room.
After he walked away, the girl with a round head next to him leaned into Jiang Xiaoyue's ear and whispered: "Is this your senior brother you always said?"
"Yeah."
"You look quite energetic," the girl with the round head blinked, "I used to hear you say that your senior brother is a genius, a super academic, and the one who ranks first in every exam?"
